title: Homilies on Exodus, Homily 13
blurb: Origen’s Homily 13 on Exodus (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–5.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homily 13 on Exodus — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Heine FOTC 71 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homily 13 §§1–5 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VI (GCS 29, 1920), Rufinus’s Latin of Homily 13. Heine FOTC 71 was not used as wording. This page is Homily 13 §§1–5 (closeout).
